_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY — NOT DEPLOYED, AND NON-DEPLOYABLE AS A SEPARATE SERVICE. The capture receipt journal is a local SQLite file under ECHO_SOURCE_CAPTURE_JOURNAL_DIR on a service's private volume; two independent Railway services get two independent volumes and NEVER share data, so a dedicated observation service would see an empty journal and hold on every observation. Do not deploy this template without a verified shared authenticated journal topology. The supported topology is the single-service sequential pipeline in railway.source-pipeline.json (agent.source_brand_pipeline_job): capture then observation in ONE process on ONE service sharing ONE journal volume. Everything defaults OFF: before any use, an operator must explicitly set ECHO_SOURCE_OBSERVATION_JOB_ENABLED placeholder to 'true', provide ECHO_SOURCE_OBSERVATION_JOB_ALLOWLIST (exact canonical gym UUIDs), ECHO_SOURCE_OBSERVATION_ENABLED, and all startup gates (see agent/source_brand_startup.py). No production values are provisioned here.
